entries.purpose: Independent deterministic test-only classic ZIP writer and controlled malformed-record mutations.
entries.author: USDZ Validation Kit contributors
entries.obligations: Include the copyright and MIT permission notice in copies or substantial portions.
entries.recipe: Compile the committed Swift 6 source with Foundation only. Construct ordered ArchiveRecipe.Entry values and call encode() or encodeWithLayout(). Inputs select raw names, payload, type, flags, method, declared sizes/CRC, extra fields, per-member comments and fixed-header patches; offsets support deterministic byte mutations. Temporary recipes supply large/adversarial cases; no large committed assets. Optional prefix and bytesBeforeDirectory insert verbatim boundary-layout bytes while preserving absolute indexed offsets, for self-extracting, gap and hidden-member recipes. Entry.payloadPatches applies deterministic payload-relative mutations only after CRC and size declarations are recorded, allowing content-corruption fixtures with matching local and central metadata. EntryType includes independently declared Unix character-device, block-device, FIFO and socket modes for namespace/type rejection fixtures; raw-name and central-header patches reproduce unsupported encodings and host/type metadata without product code. repeatedUSDALiterals(valueBytes:count:paddingBytes:) authors the original #usda 1.0 LF header, count verbatim single-delimited asset values separated by spaces, then space padding; use temporary bytes for exact/over 16 MiB layers, 4 KiB authored tokens and 100,000-token scanner boundaries. It performs no escaping, so deliberately invalid lexical vectors remain verbatim. Optional tripleDelimited selects @@@ delimiters without altering authored value bytes; raw delimiter escapes remain verbatim for resolver/lexer integration fixtures.

entries.purpose: Original deterministic PNG IHDR and JPEG SOF header vectors, bounded segment padding and controlled malformed-header mutations; header-only JPEG bytes are not valid complete-image or scene oracles.
entries.author: USDZ Validation Kit contributors
entries.obligations: Include the copyright and MIT permission notice in copies or substantial portions.
entries.recipe: Compile committed Swift 6 ImageRecipes.swift with Foundation and ArchiveRecipe.swift. pngHeader(width:height:) writes the PNG signature, 13-byte RGBA 8-bit IHDR with caller-selected big-endian dimensions and independent CRC-32. jpegHeader(marker:width:height:precision:leadingSegments:) writes SOI and one three-component SOF (default SOF0, 16x8, precision 8); SOF1/SOF2 and unsupported marker values are selected explicitly. jpegSegment(marker:fields:) encodes the two-byte inclusive length. jpegPadding(byteCount:) writes exact-sized APP1 segments of at most 65,537 total bytes with 0x42 bodies. Tests truncate every header prefix and mutate signatures, IHDR lengths including 0xffffffff, dimensions, CRC, frame lengths/counts/components and marker framing. Leading padding puts marker/length fields across 64 KiB boundaries and SOF ends at/one byte beyond 1,048,576; un-read trailing 0xab bytes model pixels. These are original header-only vectors, not decoder-validation fixtures; Fixtures.pixelPNG() supplies the original complete PNG.

entries.purpose: Bounded deterministic adversarial ZIP/USDA/PNG/JPEG integration corpus; malformed/unsupported labels apply only to explicit supported oracles, while arbitrary bit flips and truncations assert safety and determinism.
entries.author: USDZ Validation Kit contributors
entries.obligations: Include the copyright and MIT permission notice in copies or substantial portions.
entries.recipe: Compile committed Swift 6 MutationRecipes.swift with Foundation, ArchiveRecipe.swift, Fixtures.swift and ImageRecipes.swift. Call MutationRecipes.cases(seed: 0x55564B01). Exactly 251 stable IDs with per-case bytes, recipe and oracle: ZIP 121, USDA 50, PNG 37, JPEG 43. Structural cuts are at each listed field boundary and immediately before it, de-duplicated and sorted. Local-record cuts retain CD/EOCD and rebase the directory offset; directory cuts retain EOCD with adjusted size, ensuring the intended reader is reached. Local name/extra 65535 declarations cross the validated directory boundary. USDA token boundaries include comments/strings and single/triple asset delimiters; content mutations rebuild ZIP sizes/CRC so payload scanners remain eligible. PNG IHDR and JPEG SOF header-only vectors come from ImageRecipes and never certify image or scene validity. Fixed signature/length/range/metadata/namespace/token mutations are explicit in source. LCG64 wraps state = state * 6364136223846793005 + 1442695040888963407, in ZIP/USDA/PNG/JPEG order; each surface receives exactly 16 single-bit flips, byte offset = (state >> 16) % source.count and bit = (state >> 48) & 7. The fixed seed controls only these 64 flips. Reproduction writes only input.usdz inside a temporary test directory; no extraction, external tool or network access. Run sh Scripts/test-adversarial.sh.
history: 2026-10-21: Original MIT bounded 251-case corpus added for Task 23. Existing readers pass the corrected oracle corpus; no demonstrated production defect.

corpus.classification: MutationCase.oracle records each case label. Malformed labels require the named error rule. Unsupported labels require the named validatorLimitation warning, incomplete coverage and no error. Unlabeled cuts and seeded bit flips have no invented semantic expectation.

Entry/finding/message/evidence limits are asserted; no new product seam.

entries.purpose: Independent streamed deterministic temporary maximum-envelope ZIP/USDA/JPEG recipes and boundary metadata; no committed giant assets.
entries.author: USDZ Validation Kit contributors
entries.obligations: Include the copyright and MIT permission notice in copies or substantial portions.
entries.recipe: Compile committed Swift 6 source with Foundation. ResourceRecipes.write(entries:to:archiveBytes:) writes a classic stored ZIP to a caller-owned temporary URL, fixed DOS 1980-01-01, 64-byte payload alignment, CRC-32/ISO-HDLC table, at most 65536-byte stream chunks and O(entry count) bounded metadata. Segment bytes/repeated/fill retain no full archive or large member. Entry.declaredSize explicitly creates metadata-only 256MiB and aggregate512MiB declaration boundaries whose physically stored payload plus ZIP overhead cannot fit the archive ceiling. Entry.commentBytes fills central comments for exact/one-above16MiB directory sizes. archiveBytes fills only the bounded EOCD comment to reach exactly512MiB. nearArchiveLimit writes root.usda, a.wav=268435456 B bytes and b.wav=268434432 B bytes. text(tokens:tokenBytes:totalBytes:) emits #usda 1.0 LF, raw a asset tokens and space padding for lexical limits. jpegHeader(paddingBytes:) streams SOI, APP1 segments and SOF0 so the frame ends at/one byte above1048576; header-only JPEG is not a valid complete image/scene oracle. ResourceBoundaryTests opt into expensive sizes with UVK_RUN_RESOURCE_TESTS=1; small counter/metadata/token/config/report proofs always run. Every temporary file is deleted after its test.

measurementGenerator.recipe: Run python3 Scripts/verify-resources.py --executable .build/release/usdz-validator --output docs/verification/resource-results.md. Independent Python struct/zlib classic-ZIP writer uses the same fixed timestamp/alignment/segments with <=65536-byte payload chunks and no downloads. Corpus: near512MiB (each entry<=256MiB),10000 entries,16MiB+100000 self-reference tokens,1MiB JPEG scan,9990 real missing-reference findings with1100-byte names as JSON/SARIF,10001-token finding truncation, and9990 real findings with4096-byte names for operational JSON/SARIF output-cap rejection. Fixture generation/hash/report verification occur outside one /usr/bin/time -l native child per case. Darwin arm64/internalSSD required; kill/reap process group after60seconds. Actual archive corpus hashes/command/exit/report size/RSS/elapsed/toolchain/host are recorded in resource-results.md. No external checker requested. Envelope 3 expands the retained corpus with opaque numeric counts 0/250000/250001/UInt64.max, admitted compressed counts, a shared 16-entry dictionary with 8546/8547 live fields (109+234N actual work), numeric cross-layer near/over work, malformed count headers, unsupported flags, and nonexempt shared asset limits. Raw time stderr/stdout, observed typed rule/reason receipts, candidate executable hash and final generator hash are retained in the resource summary.
